nvitk.transform.rotate¶

Rotate 2D/3D image arrays around a spatial axis.

Functions¶

rotate_volume(→ nvitk.types.Image | Any)

Rotate a 2D or 3D image by angle_degrees around axis.

Module Contents¶

nvitk.transform.rotate.rotate_volume(image: nvitk.types.Image | Any, angle_degrees: float, *, axis: int = 2, order: int = 1, reshape: bool = False, mode: str = 'constant', cval: float = 0.0) → nvitk.types.Image | Any¶

Rotate a 2D or 3D image by angle_degrees around axis.

Parameters:

  • image – Image or ndarray-like volume.

  • angle_degrees – Counter-clockwise rotation (degrees) in the plane orthogonal to axis (scipy.ndimage.rotate convention).

  • axis – Axis to rotate around for 3D data (0, 1, or 2; default Z). Ignored for 2D (always in-plane).

  • order – Spline interpolation order. Use 0 for label masks.

  • reshape – If True, expand the canvas to fit the rotated content (affine is left unchanged). If False (default), keep the original shape and update the affine when present.

  • mode – Boundary fill for scipy.ndimage.rotate.

  • cval – Boundary fill for scipy.ndimage.rotate.
